original_value: TURBO FAN COOLING SYSTEMGIGABYTE turbo fan cooling system is designed for systems that use multiple graphics cards in space restricted chassis. With the vapor chamber direct touch GPU, blower fan and specially shaped exterior, it provides more airflow and better heat dissipation.THE OPTIMIZED AIRFLOWThe specially designed exterior increases the intake airflow of the graphics card in a limited space, and then the heat generated by the graphics card is quickly taken out of the entire chassis by the ultra-durable blower fan.VAPOR CHAMBER DIRECT TOUCHVapor chamber has the best thermal conductivity to transfer the heat rapidly from the GPU to the heat sink. In addition, the heat of the VRAM and the MOSFET is also conducted through the metal patch to the heat sink, and then the heat is taken out of the entire chassis by the blower fan.Double ball bearingDouble ball bearing is the most durable fan construction with a durability of over 50,000 hours. Double ball bearing has at least twice life as sleeve bearing.
